jobs.occupation: Financial Data Management Consultant, Datadriven Banking, Netcompany Banking Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping the financial sector turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities & technologies

You will become part of a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their businesses through data and insights, working at the intersection of technology and finance. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in financial data management.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• 
Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• 
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• 
Implementation of financial business logic on data for use in reporting.

• 
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• 
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within finance and data management, probably from a bank, an asset manager or similar. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex financial data and challenges. You thrive in an environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• 
ETL and Database technologies.

• 
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• 
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

• 
The financial sector, including regulatory reporting in the banking sector.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

Are you an experienced commercial professional looking for an environment where your ideas matter, decisions move quickly, and your direct contribution makes a visible impact?

We built Trustpilot to be that place.

As AI reshapes how consumers search, discover, and choose brands, Trustpilot’s unique dataset of authentic human sentiment is becoming increasingly critical. We are uniquely positioned to define how trust and reputation function in an AI-driven digital economy and we’re building an inclusive environment where curious, ambitious people can do the best work of their careers.

We’re expanding our Enterprise business across the French market, and we’re looking for collaborative, forward-thinking professionals to help shape what’s next. You’ll work with some of the region’s leading brands at a moment when AI is fundamentally changing how reputation is built and how consumers make decisions, while helping businesses use authentic human sentiment to strengthen their visibility, credibility, and competitive position in the AI economy.

If you’re energised by building new approaches, solving complex challenges, and seeing the tangible impact of your work, we’d love to hear from you.

This role requires native-level French and strong professional English language skills. It is based in our Copenhagen office.

What you’ll be doing:

• Drive Portfolio Value: Manage a portfolio of Enterprise accounts across the French market, owning customer retention, guiding successful renewals, and identifying growth opportunities through thoughtful account mapping.

• Partner for Success: Work in close partnership with dedicated Customer Success Managers (CSMs). While you lead on commercial strategy, contract growth, and negotiations, your CSM partner guides adoption, implementation, and ongoing account health, delivering a seamless, high-value experience for our clients.

• Help Build the Playbook: Bring fresh perspectives to a growing function by sharing market insights, piloting retention and expansion initiatives, and co-creating our France Enterprise strategy.

• Demonstrate Value: Deeply understand client business goals and metrics to deliver measurable ROI, establishing Trustpilot as a trusted, long-term partner.

Who you are:

• Native-level French and strong professional English language skills

• Demonstrated track record managing Enterprise-level customer portfolios, with experience driving renewals, account retention, and commercial expansion within a SaaS or subscription-based environment.

• Comfortable navigating evolving environments, taking ownership of your outcomes, and eager to help shape an Enterprise approach rather than simply following a rigid process.

• Proven ability to co-manage complex customer relationships alongside Customer Success Managers, technical leads, and cross-functional teams.

• Skilled at leading thoughtful, consultative conversations with senior leadership and key stakeholders across diverse organizations.

• Excited to move beyond standard sales approaches and help tailor solutions that truly resonate within the European market.

What’s in it for you:

• Real ownership: influence how we grow within your market

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday with an additional 5 days after 12 months of continuous employment

• 2 (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Paid parental leave

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• An international workspace at our HQ in Copenhagen that’s complete with a coffee bar and canteen, with a wide variety of refreshments available. You can opt in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price.

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

#LI-MN1

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

_Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com)  quoting the role you wish to apply for._

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

*This role is based out of our Copenhagen HQ office and requires fluent French, with strong English skills*

As an Account Manager for the French Mid-Market, you’ll join our team at the heart of the action, right on our home turf in Copenhagen. You'll be literally at the centre of where the fun happens, with a unique opportunity to drive change and see the direct impact of your work on our business growth.You will join our French Mid-Market team, working closely with both Account Executives and Account Managers.

In this role, you will own customer retention and expansion. You will act as a Trusted Advisor, developing long-term relationships and strategic success plans that ensure customers derive maximum value from Trustpilot’s products. Your expertise will be key to driving retention, minimizing churn, and maximizing growth within this critical home market.

What you'll be doing:

• Take ownership of a customer portfolio for the French market, acting as the primary point of contact.

• Analyze market trends and customer behavior within France to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.

• Establish strong relationships with customers to ensure satisfaction, product adoption, and contract renewal.

• Develop and implement tailored strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and value delivery specifically for the French market.

• Ensure a premium experience by understanding client objectives and KPIs, and ensuring Trustpilot delivers against them.

• Increase renewal rates and reduce churn.

• Identify and successfully pursue upsell opportunities and new revenue streams.

• Act as a trusted advisor, advocating client needs to internal support, product, engineering, and sales teams.

• Successfully onboard clients and ensure they fully utilize their paid subscription.

Who you are:

• Native-level in French and proficient in English.

• 3+ years of Sales/Account Management/Customer Success experience, preferably in software industries, digital or online marketing.

• A genuine commitment to deeply understanding customer needs and exceeding expectations. You view customer success as a revenue driver.

• Proven track record in SaaS or Tech sales, with consistent quota achievement.

• Experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts with a focus on achieving a high renewal/retention rate.

• Proven experience in B2B sales or account management with subscription-based models.

• Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with multiple stakeholders.

• You thrive in a team-based environment and are excited by the opportunity to work regularly with colleagues in a Copenhagen-based setting.

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

Are you ready to shape the future of airport automation and collaborate with global team members to ensure seamless integration of complex systems? As a Senior Automation Engineer at BEUMER Group, you will take ownership of mission critical projects for baggage handling solutions in major airports worldwide. Leveraging your deep technical expertise, you ensure our systems keep millions of passengers moving safely and efficiently every day.

To further expand and strengthen our team in Airport Automation we are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to join our team. You will become part of the Project Engineering team, consisting of 12 highly skilled colleagues. The team is dedicated to working with our CrisBag system for some of the world's largest airports, which also means that if in your interest, traveling will be possible. Our systems operate around the clock and handle millions of bags annually, placing high demands in reliability, scalability and maintainability. Together with the team, you’ll bring tomorrow’s automation solutions to life with immediate access to our in-house test centre for prototyping, simulation, and validation.

Explore the CrisBag baggage handling system here.

Play a crucial part in developing cutting-edge technology for project delivery

As Senior Automation Engineer, we expect you to act as a technical authority, identifying opportunities for enhancement in existing systems and processes. You will work across the full automation stack including PLC, safety systems, network infrastructure, high-level system integration, commissioning and cross-disciplinary technical coordination. As an essential part of the role you will contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes, development tools, simulation and emulation environments, testing methodologies, and software quality practices. You will participate in project definition and review meetings. Your tasks include but are not limited to:

• Developing PLC code for projects specific elements and solutions in our baggage handling system

• Defining the best solutions for specific projects

• Commissioning your PLC code in projects worldwide as well as testing your solutions virtually or at our test centre

• Reviewing layouts and solutions early in the process to secure the long-term success of our projects

• Mentor team members in code development, promoting best practices and knowledge-sharing

• Participating in the documentation of our solutions

Skilled Automation Engineer

We appreciate an inclusive mindset and the desire to be a part of a highly dedicated team, driven by the technology and world class products. We value curiosity, practical creativity, and engineers who think beyond code to create the best solutions. Moreover, we are looking for someone with the following qualifications:

• Advanced proficiency in Siemens TIA and SCL (Structured Control Language)

• Solid experience with modular software development, component-based architectures and structured PLC programming

• Speak and write English fluently

Furthermore, we expect that you possess strong coordination skills, in providing inputs for planning and resources. You thrive in a dynamic environment, and hold a proactive, detail-oriented mindset, enabling you to effectively manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams.

Culture at BEUMER

At BEUMER, we focus on creating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth. We encourage employees to explore new career paths and internal opportunities along the way. We value teamwork, and open collaboration. Our way of working is built on trust and respect for one another.

Maintaining a healthy work–life balance is a priority to us, which is why we offer flexible working options and up to two remote workdays per week. As a family-owned company, we also think long term, which means prioritizing stability, employee well-being, and strong, trust-based relationships. Further, we offer a wide range of social activities, such as padel tennis, fitness facilities, gaming, biking club and much more.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Head of Project Execution, Airport Engineering Poul Madsen on +45 5138 1904. We interview on an ongoing basis.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation, and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a work culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide

Join DynamicsPrint: A Leading Microsoft Preferred Solution for the Printing and Packaging Industry

DynamicsPrint has pioneered a Microsoft-preferred solution that is recognized as a preferred choice for the printing and packaging industry. Grounded in Microsoft 365 FO, our ISV solution covers every aspect, from quoting and production to resource planning and finance. Since our establishment in 1993, we have dedicated ourselves to the printing industry, accumulating invaluable insights and expertise. Fused with cutting-edge Microsoft technology, our knowledge positions us as trusted advisors and technology partners for the world’s leading printing companies.

ERP Consultant – Implementation

International Customers – Growing Industry – Strong Vertical Solution

We are seeking an experienced ERP Consultant with expertise in production planning to join our team. As a pivotal member of our company, you will be responsible for implementing and optimizing ERP systems, focusing specifically on production processes within the print and packaging industry.

In your role as an Implementation Consultant, you will report directly to the Consultant Manager and engage with our exciting customers in the print and packaging industry. Your primary responsibilities will include conducting GAP analysis, system specifications, manage on-site implementation, training super users, and coordinating with stakeholders. Your key responsibilities will involve:

• Conducting GAP analysis and pre-analysis on-site to understand the capabilities of both the standard solution and DynamicsPrint, identifying needs and potential gaps.

• Managing system implementation and onboarding.

• Facilitating user training and ensuring a smooth transition to the new systems for employees.

• Provide continuous support and make ongoing improvements to ERP solutions based on the company’s evolving needs.

• Collaborating with clients and stakeholders in the print and packaging sector to ensure that the solutions meet expectations and deliver tangible value.

• Coordinating with stakeholders (customers and partners).

• Learning and adapting quickly, with the expectation to independently manage projects after initial guidance in collaboration with internal and external project managers and developers.

What We’re Looking For:

Specialist, manager from the print industry or consultant with ERP experience.

You should have a strong background from the printing industry or ERP systems, excelling in functional expertise and communication, demonstrating the ability to quickly learn and adapt in dynamic environments. An as individual, you’re characterized by your ability to manage diversity, work independently, and possess adaptability, teamwork, quick learning, and good communication skills. Experience with relevant print software or ERP software such as Microsoft, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar is preferred, especially with a focus on supply chain, production planning and optimization. Your experience may come from roles as pre-press, other specialist functions or middle management in the printing and packaging industry, or an internal or external ERP consultant. Ideally, you have a relevant education within graphical design/production, a degree in economics, IT, or a related field. We offer a competitive salary package and the opportunity to join a team of highly ambitious and talented individuals based in Farum, or in a hybrid/remote setup.

We offer:

• An exciting opportunity to work with leading companies and complex projects within the print and packaging industry.

• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative work culture.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• To be part of a customer centric growth journey.

Learn more about DynamicsPrint at the DynamicsPrint Website

Information

The application and selection process will be done in collaboration with Brinch & Partners. If you would like to know more about this opportunity and the company, please feel free to contact Partner Martin Bo Sørensen by phone +45 27847406.

We look forward to receiving your CV as soon as possible through the “Apply” button below.

Our technical OT/ICS team is expanding, so we're looking for a senior technical consultant to join an ambitious cybersecurity team working with clients across the globe.

What you'll do

You'll join a team of highly skilled engineers and consultants working at the intersection of IT, Operational Technology (OT), automation, and cybersecurity – with protecting and monitoring OT networks at the core of what we do.

In this role, you'll own:

• 
Advanced threat detection and engineering: working extensively with industry-leading technology providers to deploy, test, and tune advanced threat monitoring solutions in production environments

• 
Technical implementation: leading the design and implementation of OT network segmentation projects, architecture redesign, secure remote access integration, and asset/configuration analysis

• 
Consultancy and advisory: acting as trusted advisor to clients and colleagues on architecture reviews and OT risk assessments, and translating technical risk into business impact

What you'll bring

We're looking for a seasoned OT Cybersecurity Principal Consultant with extensive experience in infrastructure solutions and technology deployment in OT environments.

The ideal candidate comes with:

• 
At least 5 years of experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, including client-facing consulting roles

• 
Demonstrated capability across critical security domains such as network segmentation, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, secure remote access, incident response, cyber threat intelligence, and Security Operations Centre enablement

• 
A track record of continuous technical development — for example, certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC, CCNA/CCNP, or product certifications with recognised OT security vendors such as Nozomi or Claroty

Clearance for SECRET (HEMMELIGT) with Danish authorities is a plus.

What we offer

We're a growing and ambitious tech startup that puts technical excellence first. We invest in the tools, tradecraft, and certifications needed to stay at the forefront of our domains, and continuously sharpen our expertise.

You'll join a team of highly skilled specialists working on complex OT cybersecurity challenges, helping shape both our capabilities and the services we bring to market.

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

For any questions about the position, contact Anders Rømer at anrs@thetechcollective.eu.

Company Description

Are you the one who brings structure when things get complex, and who walks over to ask why something has stalled rather than waiting for an email? Then you might be the Student Assistant we are looking for!

At JYSK, our Operational Centre of Excellence helps teams across IT and the business units it supports work in more stable and measurable ways. We are looking for a Student Assistant for 15 hours a week to work with data and stakeholder coordination at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus.

You start as soon as we have found the right candidate. For the first six weeks you work about one day a week, then 15 hours a week over two days, with at least one of them at the office. We start with a three-month contract and hope you stay at least 12 months. We are flexible around exams and holidays.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You work directly with the Manager of IT Operational Excellence and get real responsibility from day one. Within your first three months, you will have delivered your first piece of reporting that the IT leadership team uses.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Insight into how IT operations and continuous improvement work in an international retailer with more than 3,700 stores in 49 countries, more than 35,000 colleagues and an IT organisation of more than 400 people

• Room to shape your own role - this is a new area we are designing, and what you lean into will help define it

• A dedicated mentor, regular sparring and a network across IT that few students get

• Hands-on experience with ITIL, Lean, structured change management and the agile framework SAFe, which is how our teams work

• The option to use real cases for projects or your thesis

• Flexible hours that fit your studies and exams

• Engaged colleagues, a lunch programme with healthy and varied meals, and Friday bars

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You help us turn improvements into results, and most of that happens in conversation with people. Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Data and insight: Collect and analyse data, build dashboards, and explain what the numbers show and how our initiatives are working.

• Following up on improvement actions: Keep track of our actions, check with the owners that they are delivered, and find out why when something stalls.

• Making larger initiatives easy to join: One example is our CMDB, a map of how applications and servers connect. You create templates, plan the steps with the teams and help remove what blocks them.

• Working with people: Talk to colleagues instead of hiding behind the screen. Join a stand-up, send a Slack message or walk over, and make it easy for people to help.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You do not need experience. We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Is curious about data and what it tells you, with Excel as a good starting point

• Enjoys bringing structure to messy tasks

• Likes talking to people and following up until things get done

• Is motivated to learn, not least how IT runs a large retail business

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education programme with at least 12 months of studies left

• Communicates fluently in English. Danish is a plus

• Can be at the office in Aarhus at least one day a week

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Manager of IT Operational Excellence, Jan B. Olsen at +45 2779 3597.

We interview on an ongoing basis and remove the ad once we have found the right candidate. You may be asked to work through a short case of about one hour.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click "I'm interested/Apply", you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values - Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit - express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Company Description

Are you motivated by shaping the future of JYSK through architectural direction rather than specific technologies? Can you inspire and coach teams to turn business ambitions into sustainable solutions? Do you thrive in the space between business and technology, translating strategic objectives into architectural guidance and helping others make sound decisions?

The technologies may change, but your passion for creating clear direction, strong collaboration, and sustainable architecture remains constant.

Are you experienced in within the domain of retail solutions and have a strong knowledge of what matters in software architecture within this domain?

Then you could be the one we are looking for!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

In JYSK your official title will be Release Train Architect and you will shape the architecture within our retail domain and influence the broader direction across JYSK—all in an informal and collaborative environment.

JYSK has strong ambitions in omnichannel commerce for creating even better customer experiences across all our channels. With over 3,500 stores and more than 100 new openings each year, retail is a core part of our IT landscape.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Sparring and feedback from skilled colleagues.

• A job where you get the opportunity to develop professionally and personally.

• A workplace in an exciting international company where results, expansion and development have a high priority.

• A relaxed and open minded atmosphere with rich opportunities to cooperate with colleagues at all levels of the organisation.

• Several social activities during the year, including Friday bars, DHL run, Christmas party etc.

• A healthy work-life balance as well as a strong company culture with a short distance from decision to action.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As part of the leadership team for our Retail Excellence ART consisting of 7 product teams, you will play a key role as the main architect in shaping the architecture that supports JYSK stores and the retail capabilities that enable thousands of colleagues to serve customers every day. You will help guide the evolution of our store systems landscape, ensuring that solutions are sustainable, scalable, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural principles.

In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, product teams, engineers, and fellow architects to provide architectural direction, facilitate decision-making, and create alignment across the organization. You are not expected to be the technical expert in every solution. Instead, you are a leader, coach, and trusted sparring partner who enables others to make sound architectural decisions and translate business ambitions into valuable outcomes.

Reporting to our Senior Enterprise Architect you will join a team of three Enterprise Architects and five Release Train Architects.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Ensuring technical governance and architectural roadmap within the ART.

• Collaboration and alignment with architects and solution specialists across the organisation.

• Writing solution designs within the domain of our retail and store operations.

• Guiding teams to the right solutions and being a visible sparring partner.

• Being a central sparring partner with external vendor on the POS system, being able to translate between tech and business.

jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.

Qualifications and specific competences:
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:
• A MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related filed.
• A strong academic background and interest in HVAC systems in buildings, and fluid and thermal systems modelling.
• Proven experience in data analytics, machine learning, and optimisation.
• Ability to program using Python, R, MATLAB or similar platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and spoken English skills.It is considered an advantage if you have:
• Knowledge of animal heat stress and animal welfare.
• Knowledge of Large Language Model, stochastic modelling, system identification.
• Experience with CFD simulations.

jobs.occupation: PhD Scholarship in Sustainable Supply Chain Management and Organization - DTU Management
jobs.description:
Are you a collaborative and ambitious master's graduate with strong intercultural awareness and a curiosity for exploring sustainability challenges across different contexts and disciplines? Would you like to help shape the next generation of sustainable and regenerative global supply chains through a unique collaboration between the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and the University of Nairobi, Kenya? DTU Management (Department of Technology, Management, and Economics) invites applications for a three-year PhD scholarship at the intersection of supply chain management and organization studies. Focusing on global agricultural commodity chains, the project explores how supply chains can create positive environmental and social impacts rather than simply reducing negative ones. It examines regenerative approaches that renew ecological and social systems while being collectively organized with local communities.

The PhD position is anchored at DTU Management and contributes to the department's strategic focus on developing viable and sustainable systems. You will join an international research environment at the forefront of sustainable supply chain management and organization studies, collaborating with researchers and partners in Denmark and Kenya. The project combines literature-based and empirical research on regenerative agri-food supply chains with fieldwork and data collection in Denmark and Kenya. The project will be supervised by Associate Professor Lærke Højgaard Christiansen and Assistant Professor Lara Schilling at DTU and will include an extended research stay at the University of Nairobi under the co-supervision of Senior Lecturer Thomas Ombati and Lecturer Veronica Wambui Mwangi. 

Based in Copenhagen – consistently ranked among the world's most livable cities – you will enjoy a high quality of life, a safe and sustainable urban environment, and a thriving cultural scene. At the same time, you'll be part of a vibrant, interdisciplinary research community at one of Europe's top technical universities, known for its commitment to innovation, societal impact, and diversity.

Responsibilities and qualifications
As a PhD candidate, you will investigate how global agricultural commodity chains, such as tea or coffee, can be managed based on regenerative principles. The project offers a unique opportunity to develop an international and interdisciplinary research profile at the intersection of organization studies and supply chain management. As part of the DTU Management PhD Program, you will follow a structured research and training program that combines independent research, academic coursework, teaching, and professional development.

Mandatory requirements:

• You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.
• An educational background in the social sciences 
• A familiarity with supply chain management, organization studies, or related fields such as (human) geography
• Have a strong interest in sustainability, regenerative systems, and the organization of global supply chains
• Strong speaking and writing skills in English
Further, the following qualities will be valued highly in the assessment:

• Research vision and potential 
• Evidence of academic accomplishment (e.g., high grades, timely graduation)
• Knowledge and experience with qualitative research methods and empirical fieldwork 
• Scholarly/academic writing skills 
• Familiarity with Kenya’s socio-cultural context, or experience in settings with transferable relevance, is desirable but not required.
Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union. The period of employment is 3 years. The envisaged starting date is as soon as possible. The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Lara Schilling (larasc@dtu.dk) and Lærke Højgaard Christiansen (laerc@dtu.dk)

You can read more about the Department of Technology, Management and Economics at https://www.man.dtu.dk/english

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 15 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A research statement (2–3 pages) outlining your research ideas and explaining your suitability for carrying out the project. Please engage with relevant scholarly literature on regenerative supply chains and organization. The statement is intended to demonstrate your research interests and potential; it is not a binding proposal, and the research plan may be further developed and refined in collaboration with the supervisory team upon enrolment in the PhD program.
• One copy of a selected written work (e.g., master’s thesis)
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Management
DTU Management conducts excellent research at the intersection of management, technology and economics. We develop solutions in close cooperation with companies and public authorities. Our research aims at strengthening welfare, productivity and sustainability. A key element is the role of technology and its interaction with industry and individuals. The department offers a wide range of courses and programs at bachelor, master, and PhD levels across DTU's study programs. The department has 250+ employees with around half of staff coming from abroad. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Rzeźnik - Rozbiór Łopatki Wieprzowej / Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning
jobs.description:
Pracuj w Danii jako rzeźnik – atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie, elastyczność i stabilne warunki pracy. Danish Crown to jedna z największych firm spożywczych w Europie. Oferujemy stabilne warunki zatrudnienia i pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku.

Opis stanowiska

• Wykonywanie rozbioru łopatki wieprzowej zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami jakości i wydajności.

• Precyzyjna praca nożem na linii produkcyjnej, z dbałością o detale.

• Monitorowanie i utrzymywanie wysokiej jakości cięcia oraz efektywności pracy.

• Ścisłe przestrzeganie zasad higieny i bezpieczeństwa pracy na każdym etapie produkcji

Wymagania

• Ugruntowane doświadczenie w rozbiorze mięsa, najlepiej w pracy z łopatką wieprzową lub przodami.

• Doskonała umiejętność sprawnego i precyzyjnego posługiwania się nożem.

• Udokumentowane doświadczenie w pracy na ubojni lub w zakładzie mięsnym.

• Zdolność do efektywnej i samodzielnej pracy w tempie produkcyjnym od pierwszego dnia.

• Sprawność fizyczna oraz odpowiedzialność w wykonywaniu powierzonych zadań.

Oferujemy

• Atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie godzinowe z dodatkami, 176 dkk + 12,20% czyli 197,58 dkk z możliwością wzrostu po przejściu na system akordowy.

• Stabilne zatrudnienie bezpośrednio u duńskiego pracodawcy Danish Crown, z pełnym pakietem socjalnym (urlop, emerytura).

• Wsparcie w procesie relokacji i adaptacji w Danii (CPR, podatki, ubezpieczenie, zakwaterowanie).

• Pomoc w języku polskim oraz innych językach, a także wprowadzenie w życie i pracę w Danii.

English version:

Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.
The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note: You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)
• Knife work in high-volume pork production
• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield
• Following hygiene and safety procedures
• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning
• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends
• Good knife skills
• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant
• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment
• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer: 

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift
Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.
If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift
32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application
If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Ewa Pedersen email ewape@jks.dk telefon: +45.61204070.

We look forward to hearing from you!
